// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / string / literals
const text = "héllo";
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
//           ^^^^^^^ string.quoted.double.ds

// types / string / chars
const initial: char = 'D';
//             ^^^^ support.type.builtin.ds
//                    ^^^ string.quoted.single.ds

// types / string / code point iteration
for (const c of text) {
// <- keyword.control.loop.ds
    c satisfies char;
}

// types / string / views
const units = text.units();
//                 ^^^^^ entity.name.function.call.ds
const bytes = text.bytes();
//                 ^^^^^ entity.name.function.call.ds
